description_en: Calls a published Mobile-Use Agent, supporting both Standard Edition and Dedicated Edition. Submits task text and the current screenshot, passes device and application context through metadata, and returns the next mobile UI operation via SSE. The caller executes the UI operation, then continues calling with the session ID and the latest screenshot
description_zh: 调用已发布的 Mobile-Use Agent，支持标准版和专属版。提交任务文本和当前屏幕截图，通过 metadata 传入设备与应用上下文，以 SSE 返回下一步手机界面操作。界面操作由调用方执行，执行后携带会话 ID 和最新截图继续调用
name: GuiChatCompletionStream

parameters.help_en: The Agent instance access key, used for QICloud Customer API authentication
parameters.help_zh: Agent 实例访问密钥，用于 QICloud Customer 接口鉴权
parameters.name: x_qi_agent_api_key

parameters.help_en: The published Mobile-Use Agent instance ID. It must correspond to the X-QI-Agent-Api-Key
parameters.help_zh: 已发布的 Mobile-Use Agent 实例 ID，必须与 X-QI-Agent-Api-Key 对应
parameters.name: x_qi_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The optional session identifier. Can be omitted in the first step, in which case the server generates one. Must be passed back with the same value in subsequent Mobile-Use Agent steps to resume state
parameters.help_zh: 可选会话标识。首步可省略，由服务端生成；后续 Mobile-Use Agent 步骤必须传回同一值续接状态
parameters.name: x_qi_session_id

parameters.help_en: The whitelist of token IDs allowed for generation
parameters.help_zh: 允许生成的 Token ID 白名单
parameters.name: allowed_token_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of words or strings prohibited from generation
parameters.help_zh: 禁止生成的词或字符串列表
parameters.name: bad_words

fields.help_en: The chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking parameter. A request-level toggle for model thinking that overrides the default value of the same name. The Mobile-Use Agent response does not return reasoning_content when this toggle is enabled
fields.help_zh: chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking：请求级模型思考开关，覆盖同名默认值。Mobile-Use Agent 响应不会因开启该开关而返回 reasoning_content
fields.name: enable_thinking

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to preserve existing thinking context in subsequent rounds. Passed as-is per vLLM/Qwen chat_template_kwargs
fields.help_zh: 是否在续轮中保留已有思考上下文；按 vLLM/Qwen chat_template_kwargs 原样透传
fields.name: preserve_thinking

parameters.help_en: The vLLM/OpenAI-compatible template parameter object. Request values override model defaults of the same name and are passed as-is to the Mobile-Use Agent primary model
parameters.help_zh: vLLM/OpenAI-Compatible 模板参数对象。请求值会覆盖模型默认同名值并原样传给 Mobile-Use Agent 主模型
parameters.name: chat_template_kwargs

parameters.help_en: The frequency penalty parameter, passed through to the Mobile-Use Agent primary model
parameters.help_zh: 频率惩罚参数，透传给 Mobile-Use Agent 主模型
parameters.name: frequency_penalty

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to ignore the EOS token and continue generation
parameters.help_zh: 是否忽略 EOS 并继续生成
parameters.name: ignore_eos

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to request the upstream to generate reasoning fields. The Mobile-Use Agent client-facing result does not directly expose internal thinking
parameters.help_zh: 是否请求上游生成推理字段；Mobile-Use Agent 对客结果不会直接暴露内部思考
parameters.name: include_reasoning

parameters.help_en: A model-compatible parameter. The JSON field is logprobs. Whether it is accepted and takes effect depends on the model used by the instance. The current Mobile-Use Agent response does not provide token-level log probability details
parameters.help_zh: 模型兼容参数，JSON 字段为 logprobs。是否接受及生效取决于实例所用模型；当前 Mobile-Use Agent 响应不提供 Token 对数概率明细
parameters.name: logprobs

parameters.help_en: The OpenAI-compatible maximum completion token count. Must be greater than 0 if provided
parameters.help_zh: OpenAI 兼容最大补全 Token 数，提供时必须大于 0
parameters.name: max_completion_tokens

parameters.help_en: The OpenAI-compatible maximum generation token count. Must be greater than 0 if provided
parameters.help_zh: OpenAI 兼容最大生成 Token 数，提供时必须大于 0
parameters.name: max_tokens

fields.help_en: The compatible inline image field for input_image. Accepts a Base64 Data URL
fields.help_zh: input_image 的兼容内联图片字段；可传 Base64 Data URL
fields.name: image_data

fields.help_en: The publicly accessible HTTPS image URL or Base64 image Data URL. Each user message per round must contain exactly one current screenshot. Expired or inaccessible image URLs are rejected
fields.help_zh: 公开可访问的 HTTPS 图片 URL，或 Base64 图片 Data URL。每轮 user 消息必须且只能包含一张当前截图；已过期或无法访问的图片地址会被拒绝
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The screenshot reference. Supports an image_url string or an object containing url. The object form is shown here
fields.help_zh: 截图引用。支持 image_url 字符串或包含 url 的对象；此处展示对象形式
fields.name: image_url

fields.help_en: The text content that describes the current operation goal or supplements the current page state
fields.help_zh: 文本内容，可描述当前操作目标或补充当前页面状态
fields.name: text

fields.help_en: The content item type. Use text or input_text for text. Use image_url or input_image for screenshots
fields.help_zh: 内容项类型。文本使用 text 或 input_text；截图使用 image_url 或 input_image
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The message content. A user message uses a content array containing exactly one current screenshot, optionally with task text. Screenshots support public HTTPS URLs or Base64 image Data URLs. When role=tool, specify the actual execution result of the previous action, which can be a non-empty string, object, or array
fields.help_zh: 消息内容。user 使用内容数组，包含恰好一张当前截图，并可附加任务文字；截图支持公开 HTTPS URL 或 Base64 图片 Data URL。role=tool 时填上一动作的真实执行结果，可为非空字符串、对象或数组
fields.name: content

fields.help_en: The message role. The current input must end with user. If a previous round execution receipt exists, the preceding message must be tool
fields.help_zh: 消息角色。当前输入必须以 user 结尾；存在上一轮执行回执时前一条必须为 tool
fields.name: role

fields.help_en: Required when role=tool. References the tool_call id from the previous Mobile-Use Agent response
fields.help_zh: role=tool 时必填，引用上一轮 Mobile-Use Agent 响应的 tool_call id
fields.name: tool_call_id

parameters.help_en: The messages for the current Mobile-Use Agent step. The first step can contain only one user message. Subsequent steps can contain only one tool message followed by one user message. Full multi-turn history is not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 当前 Mobile-Use Agent 步骤消息。首步只能包含一条 user；后续步骤只能是一条 tool 后跟一条 user，不允许携带完整多轮历史
parameters.name: messages

fields.help_en: The compatible alias for available_apps. Also an array of app name strings
fields.help_zh: available_apps 的兼容别名；同样是 App 名称字符串数组
fields.name: app_list

fields.help_en: The supplementary app name list for Mobile-Use Agent Standard Edition. The JSON field is available_apps. A newly passed list replaces the previous supplementary items, but the default application is retained. An empty array does not clear the default application. Mobile-Use Agent Dedicated Edition does not use this list
fields.help_zh: Mobile-Use Agent 标准版 的应用名称补充列表，JSON 字段为 available_apps。新传入列表替换之前的补充项，但默认应用仍保留；空数组不清空默认应用。Mobile-Use Agent 专属版 不使用此列表
fields.name: available_apps

fields.help_en: The Mobile-Use Agent Harness receipt text for legacy clients. Cannot be passed together with a preceding tool message. New clients should use [tool, user] messages instead
fields.help_zh: 旧客户端的 Mobile-Use Agent Harness 回执文本；与前置 tool 消息不能同时传。新客户端优先使用 [tool,user] 消息
fields.name: harness_message

fields.help_en: The screen height as a positive integer. For Base64 images, width and height are parsed from the image itself. For URL images, this value is used as the runtime screen size
fields.help_zh: 屏幕高度正整数。base64 图片会从图片本身解析宽高；URL 图片时该值用于运行时屏幕尺寸
fields.name: screen_height

fields.help_en: The screen width as a positive integer. For Base64 images, width and height are parsed from the image itself. For URL images, this value is used as the runtime screen size
fields.help_zh: 屏幕宽度正整数。base64 图片会从图片本身解析宽高；URL 图片时该值用于运行时屏幕尺寸
fields.name: screen_width

parameters.help_en: The Mobile-Use Agent step metadata. Supports screen_width, screen_height, available_apps, and the compatible field harness_message. Tool receipts and harness_message cannot be passed at the same time
parameters.help_zh: Mobile-Use Agent 步骤元数据。支持 screen_width、screen_height、available_apps 和兼容字段 harness_message；tool 回执与 harness_message 不可同时传
parameters.name: metadata

parameters.help_en: The vLLM Min-P sampling parameter
parameters.help_zh: vLLM Min-P 采样参数
parameters.name: min_p

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of tokens to generate
parameters.help_zh: 最少生成 Token 数
parameters.name: min_tokens

fields.help_en: Example: the maximum number of dynamic image patches allowed by the vision model
fields.help_zh: 示例：视觉模型允许的最大动态图像 patch 数
fields.name: max_dynamic_patch

parameters.help_en: Multimodal preprocessor parameters, passed through to the Mobile-Use Agent primary model as-is by key
parameters.help_zh: 多模态预处理器参数，按键原样透传给 Mobile-Use Agent 主模型
parameters.name: mm_processor_kwargs

parameters.help_en: Reserved for OpenAI client compatibility. Ignored during routing. The model is determined by the published instance configuration, and the model field in the response is always an empty string
parameters.help_zh: 为 OpenAI 客户端兼容保留；路由时忽略，模型由实例已发布配置决定，响应 model 固定为空字符串
parameters.name: model

parameters.help_en: Set this to 1. Whether the model accepts this parameter depends on the model. The current Mobile-Use Agent response does not return multiple candidate actions
parameters.help_zh: 建议设为 1。该参数是否被模型接受取决于模型；当前 Mobile-Use Agent 响应不会透出多个候选动作
parameters.name: n

parameters.help_en: The model-compatible parallel tool calling switch. This does not expand the set of Mobile-Use Agent actions available through this operation
parameters.help_zh: 模型兼容的并行工具调用开关，不会扩大本接口可用的 Mobile-Use Agent 动作集合
parameters.name: parallel_tool_calls

parameters.help_en: The presence penalty parameter, passed through to the Mobile-Use Agent primary model
parameters.help_zh: 存在惩罚参数，透传给 Mobile-Use Agent 主模型
parameters.name: presence_penalty

parameters.help_en: A model-compatible parameter. The JSON field is prompt_logprobs. Whether the model accepts this parameter depends on the model. The current Mobile-Use Agent response does not return input token probability details
parameters.help_zh: 模型兼容参数，JSON 字段为 prompt_logprobs。是否接受取决于模型；当前 Mobile-Use Agent 响应不返回输入 Token 概率明细
parameters.name: prompt_logprobs

parameters.help_en: The OpenAI-compatible reasoning effort, such as low, medium, or high
parameters.help_zh: OpenAI 兼容推理强度，例如 low、medium、high
parameters.name: reasoning_effort

parameters.help_en: The vLLM repetition penalty parameter
parameters.help_zh: vLLM 重复惩罚参数
parameters.name: repetition_penalty

fields.help_en: The response format type, such as text, json_object, or json_schema
fields.help_zh: 响应格式类型，例如 text、json_object 或 json_schema
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: A model-compatible structured output option. This does not change the final Mobile-Use Agent tool invocation structure of this operation. Avoid setting output constraints that conflict with the action protocol
parameters.help_zh: 模型兼容的结构化输出选项，不改变本接口最终的 Mobile-Use Agent 工具调用结构。请避免设置与动作协议冲突的输出约束
parameters.name: response_format

parameters.help_en: The random seed
parameters.help_zh: 随机种子
parameters.name: seed

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to skip special tokens
parameters.help_zh: 是否跳过特殊 Token
parameters.name: skip_special_tokens

parameters.help_en: The stop sequences. Compatible with a single string or a string array. The array form is shown here
parameters.help_zh: 停止序列。兼容单个字符串或字符串数组；此处展示数组形式
parameters.name: stop

parameters.help_en: The vLLM stop token ID list
parameters.help_zh: vLLM 停止 Token ID 列表
parameters.name: stop_token_ids

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use SSE streaming responses. This parameter must be set to true for this operation
parameters.help_zh: 是否使用 SSE 流式响应。本接口必须传 true
parameters.name: stream

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to output a usage statistics chunk before data:[DONE]
fields.help_zh: 是否在 data:[DONE] 之前输出 usage 统计块
fields.name: include_usage

parameters.help_en: The OpenAI-compatible streaming options
parameters.help_zh: OpenAI 兼容流式选项
parameters.name: stream_options

fields.help_en: The set of allowed enumeration text values
fields.name: choice

parameters.help_en: The vLLM structured output constraints
parameters.help_zh: vLLM 结构化输出约束
parameters.name: structured_outputs

parameters.help_en: The sampling temperature, which overrides the Mobile-Use Agent primary model default
parameters.help_zh: 采样温度，覆盖 Mobile-Use Agent 主模型默认值
parameters.name: temperature

parameters.help_en: The vLLM Top-K sampling parameter
parameters.help_zh: vLLM Top-K 采样参数
parameters.name: topk

parameters.help_en: A model-compatible parameter. The JSON field is top_logprobs. Whether the model accepts this parameter depends on the model. The current Mobile-Use Agent response does not return candidate token probability details
parameters.help_zh: 模型兼容参数，JSON 字段为 top_logprobs。是否接受取决于模型；当前 Mobile-Use Agent 响应不返回候选 Token 概率明细
parameters.name: top_logprobs

parameters.help_en: The Top-P nucleus sampling parameter, which overrides the Mobile-Use Agent primary model default
parameters.help_zh: Top-P 核采样参数，覆盖 Mobile-Use Agent 主模型默认值
parameters.name: topp

schema.description_en: The SSE streaming response metadata. Business events are returned continuously and end with data:[DONE]. For the complete format, see the response elements description
schema.description_zh: SSE 流式响应元数据。业务事件连续返回，最终以 data:[DONE] 结束；完整格式见返回参数补充说明

requestId.description_en: The request identity generated by the POP gateway, used for gateway Tracing Analysis. For the Agent request ID, use qi_request_id in the SSE body
requestId.description_zh: 由 POP 网关生成的请求标识，用于网关链路追踪；Agent 请求 ID 以 SSE 正文中的 qi_request_id 为准

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The Mobile-Use Agent call request body. The first call submits the current goal and screenshot. Subsequent rounds submit the actual result of the previous action along with a new screenshot, without replaying message history. Chat Completions fields use snake_case. Set stream to true
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: Mobile-Use Agent 调用请求体。首次调用提交当前目标和截图；续轮提交上一动作真实结果及新截图，不重放历史消息。Chat Completions 字段使用 snake_case，stream 设为 true
v1_body_parameters.name: body
